The top medical device distributors and direct-selling manufacturers in Europe include major multinational enterprises and specialized regional networks. Leading direct suppliers and enterprise distributors dominate through massive market shares, while dedicated networks like Healthcare 21 and Kebomed handle multi-market clinical logistics. [](https://tracxn.com/d/explore/medical-device-distributors-startups-in-europe/__u6sjVICpUG1Vk9v2naLeTmVshwUYwEWQgIMYqkqRO38/companies)

- **Medtronic** (Ireland/US): Market leader across Western Europe for cardiovascular, surgical, and diabetes technologies \[0.5\].

- **Siemens Healthineers** (Germany): Dominant supplier specializing in diagnostic imaging and clinical engineering.

- **B. Braun Melsungen** (Germany): Major European provider of surgical instruments, infusion systems, and hospital care disposables

- **Abbott Laboratories** (US/Germany): Leading provider of diabetes care (FreeStyle Libre) and diagnostics distribution \[0.5\].

- **Johnson & Johnson MedTech** (US/Belgium): Extensive centralized European warehousing supplying major hospital networks \[0.5\]. [](https://mdxcro.com/medtech-companies-europe/)

### Dedicated Third-Party & Independent Distributors

- **Healthcare 21 Group**: One of the largest dedicated medical device distributors in the UK and Ireland, partnering with global tech brands.

- **Kebomed Group**: Independent pan-European distributor operating across the Nordics, Central Europe, and the UK.

- **Asker Healthcare Group**: Major regional provider supplying medical consumables and solutions to healthcare sectors. [](https://www.kebomed.com/about-kebomed/)
